title: Break a longer Seedance sequence into short, time-coded shots (e.g., 0–3s…
content:
Break a longer Seedance sequence into short, time-coded shots (e.g., 0–3s, 3–5s) and prompt each shot separately with its own camera language and action beats.

Specify camera framing and movement explicitly in each shot prompt (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt up, corridor cam, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back to wide).

Control pacing and transitions by prompting hard cuts and frame counts (e.g., rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition) for transformation beats.

Lock lighting and color mood with concrete descriptors (overcast daylight through tall windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light) to keep continuity across shots.

Add physical environment anchors and props (desk rows, overturned desks, scattered notebooks, green chalkboard, corridor door position) to stabilize scene layout and staging.

Prompt slow motion and impact detail for action clarity (close-up slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion, frame-by-frame shards/fluid) when depicting hits.

Include dialogue lines with language tags and translations in the shot prompt to guide subtitle/voice intent (Japanese line + translation).

es.content:
Desglosa una secuencia más larga de Seedance en planos cortos con código temporal (p. ej., 0–3 s, 3–5 s) y redacta un prompt para cada plano por separado, con su propio lenguaje de cámara y sus beats de acción.

Especifica de forma explícita el encuadre y el movimiento de cámara en cada prompt de plano (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt up, corridor cam, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back to wide).

Controla el ritmo y las transiciones indicando hard cuts y el número de frames (p. ej., rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition) para los beats de transformación.

Bloquea la iluminación y el tono cromático con descriptores concretos (overcast daylight through tall windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light) para mantener la continuidad entre planos.

Añade anclajes físicos del entorno y props (desk rows, overturned desks, scattered notebooks, green chalkboard, corridor door position) para estabilizar la disposición de la escena y la puesta en escena.

Indica slow motion y detalles de impacto para dar claridad a la acción (close-up slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion, frame-by-frame shards/fluid) cuando representes golpes.

Incluye líneas de diálogo con etiquetas de idioma y traducciones en el prompt del plano para guiar la intención de subtítulos/voz (línea en japonés + traducción).

fr.content:
Décomposez une séquence Seedance plus longue en plans courts, horodatés (par ex. 0–3 s, 3–5 s), et rédigez un prompt séparé pour chaque plan avec son propre langage de caméra et ses beats d’action.

Précisez explicitement le cadrage et le mouvement de caméra dans chaque prompt de plan (plan fixe en contre-plongée, gros plan, plan large de révélation, tilt vertical rapide vers le haut, caméra de couloir, angle hollandais bas, whip-pan, orbite rapide, recul vers un plan large).

Contrôlez le rythme et les transitions en demandant des cuts francs et des comptages d’images (par ex. cut rapide en trois images, cuts francs, aucune transition) pour les beats de transformation.

Verrouillez l’éclairage et l’ambiance colorimétrique avec des descriptions concrètes (lumière du jour couverte à travers de hautes fenêtres à droite, salle de classe gris-vert froide, lumière bleu-gris glacée) afin de maintenir la continuité entre les plans.

Ajoutez des repères physiques de l’environnement et des accessoires (rangées de bureaux, bureaux renversés, cahiers éparpillés, tableau noir vert, position de la porte du couloir) pour stabiliser la disposition du décor et la mise en scène.

Demandez un ralenti et des détails d’impact pour clarifier l’action (gros plan ralenti, très gros plan ralenti, éclats/liquides image par image) lorsque vous décrivez des coups.

Incluez les répliques avec des balises de langue et leurs traductions dans le prompt du plan pour guider l’intention des sous-titres/de la voix (ligne japonaise + traduction).

ja.content:
長めの Seedance シーケンスは、短いタイムコード付きショット（例: 0–3s、3–5s）に分割し、各ショットをそれぞれ独立した prompt として、固有の camera language と action beats で指定します。

各ショットの prompt では、camera framing と movement を明確に指定します（low static shot、close-up、wide reveal、fast vertical tilt up、corridor cam、low dutch-angle、whip-pan、fast orbit、pull back to wide など）。

変身のビートでは、hard cuts と frame counts（例: rapid three-frame cut、hard cuts、no transition）を prompt して、pacing と transitions を制御します。

照明と色調は、具体的な描写で固定します（overcast daylight through tall windows on the right、cool grey-teal classroom、cold blue-grey light など）。これにより、ショット間の continuity を保ちます。

desk rows、overturned desks、scattered notebooks、green chalkboard、corridor door position など、物理的な環境のアンカーや小道具を追加して、scene layout と staging を安定させます。

ヒットを描写する際は、slow motion と impact detail を指定して action の明瞭さを高めます（close-up slow motion、extreme close-up slow motion、frame-by-frame shards/fluid など）。

字幕や音声の意図を導くために、shot prompt 内に language tags と翻訳付きの dialogue lines を含めます（Japanese line + translation）。

각 샷 prompt마다 camera framing과 movement를 명시적으로 지정하세요(예: low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt up, corridor cam, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back to wide).

변신 장면에서는 hard cuts와 frame counts를 prompt하여 pacing과 transitions를 제어하세요(예: rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition).

샷 간 연속성을 유지하기 위해 lighting과 color mood를 구체적인 묘사로 고정하세요(예: overcast daylight through tall windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light).

장면의 레이아웃과 staging을 안정화하기 위해 물리적 환경 앵커와 소품을 추가하세요(예: desk rows, overturned desks, scattered notebooks, green chalkboard, corridor door position).

샷 prompt 안에 language tags와 번역이 포함된 dialogue lines를 넣어 subtitle/voice 의도를 안내하세요(예: Japanese line + translation).

pt.content:
Divida uma sequência mais longa do Seedance em tomadas curtas, com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, 0–3s, 3–5s), e faça o prompt de cada tomada separadamente, com sua própria linguagem de câmera e beats de ação.

Especifique explicitamente o enquadramento e o movimento de câmera em cada prompt de tomada (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt up, corridor cam, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back to wide).

Controle o ritmo e as transições usando hard cuts e contagem de frames no prompt (por exemplo, rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition) para beats de transformação.

Trave a iluminação e o clima de cor com descritores concretos (overcast daylight through tall windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light) para manter a continuidade entre as tomadas.

Adicione âncoras físicas do ambiente e props (desk rows, overturned desks, scattered notebooks, green chalkboard, corridor door position) para estabilizar o layout da cena e a encenação.

Use slow motion e detalhes de impacto para dar clareza à ação (close-up slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion, frame-by-frame shards/fluid) ao retratar golpes.

Inclua falas com tags de idioma e traduções no prompt da tomada para orientar a intenção de legenda/voz (Japanese line + translation).

zh.content:
将较长的 Seedance 序列拆分为短的、带时间码的镜头（例如 0–3s、3–5s），并为每个镜头分别编写 prompt，使用各自的 camera language 和 action beats。

在每个镜头 prompt 中明确指定 camera framing 和 movement（low static shot、close-up、wide reveal、fast vertical tilt up、corridor cam、low dutch-angle、whip-pan、fast orbit、pull back to wide）。

通过在转场镜头中提示 hard cuts 和 frame counts（例如 rapid three-frame cut、hard cuts、no transition）来控制节奏和过渡，尤其适用于 transformation beats。

用具体的描述锁定 lighting 和 color mood（overcast daylight through tall windows on the right、cool grey-teal classroom、cold blue-grey light），以保持跨镜头的一致性。

加入物理环境锚点和道具（desk rows、overturned desks、scattered notebooks、green chalkboard、corridor door position），以稳定场景布局和调度。

在表现打击时，提示 slow motion 和 impact detail 以增强动作清晰度（close-up slow motion、extreme close-up slow motion、frame-by-frame shards/fluid）。

在镜头 prompt 中加入带语言标签和翻译的对白台词，以引导字幕/配音意图（Japanese line + translation）。
